summary.text: Kellie Keenan is the Republican nominee for Rhode Island's 1st District. In her Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey she describes herself as a public health professional, small business owner, wife and mother of three daughters with more than a decade of experience in healthcare and community programs. She is running on infrastructure and permitting reform, community health centers, and housing and energy affordability.

paragraphs.text: Earned a high school diploma from Boston Latin School and an advanced certificate in public health management from Suffolk University.
Describes herself as a lifelong New Englander and has worked more than a decade in healthcare and community health operations, including with Community Health Centers and federally funded programs.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as public administration.
Describes herself as a wife, mother of three daughters, and small business owner who is not a career politician.
Advanced from the September 9, 2026 Republican primary for the 1st District, in which she was the only candidate on the ballot.
